title: Answering an Easier Question
coreMove: name the question you actually answered and compare it with the question you were asked
sourcePressure: shows that hard questions are often answered by easier ones without the swap being noticed
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: turning substitution into deliberate evasion rather than an unnoticed mental shortcut

hook: opening with a named bias definition for Answering an Easier Question
starting in a lecture hall or generic seminar
counterintuition: the obvious advice is simply slow down
smart people are immune if they know the term
tryThisNow: write three lessons in a journal
examples: student in a classroom guessing an answer
